newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps broadly steady in drifting market.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps broadly steady in drifting market.

text.p: European oil swaps were steady on Monday in generally thin markets.
Brent CFDs were a shade softer, but not significantly weaker, while fuel edged up very narrowly and gasoline and naphtha held steady.

Brent CFDs for June 16-20 were pegged at -60/59 cents under August Brent crude compared with -56 cents under on Friday while June 23-28 was unchanged at around -50 cents under. Dealers said June 30-July 4 was flat at -46/47 but that July 7- July 11 eased back a touch to -44 from -40 cents. Nothing was heard done.
Heavy fuel also got off to a slow start, albeit a touch stronger. Dealers said July was done at $84 with August in contango by 50 cents to $1.

Gasoline was busier on the wet than dry with eurograde barges going at $188 fob ARA for storage, $189 fob AR and $191 fob ARA for refinery material. Swaps were pegged at $184.50 for July and essentially flat for August.
Gas oil crack spreads were broadly unchanged with 4Q97 slipping back to $4.55 from $4.60, 1Q98 a touch firmer at $4.58 and 2Q98 easing back to a little over $4 from $4.10.
